name: Mobot: Log Analysis or Security Reponse Usage
description: Dashboard uses search audit data to show queries run by copilot or mobot.
title: Mobot: Log Analysis or Security Reponse Usage

panels.title: Query Details - Mobot - sorted by billed_scan_gb

queries.queryString:
(_view=sumologic_search_usage_per_query) 
( query_type=Mobot) not user_name=*sumosupport*
user_name={{user_name}} 
query={{query_pattern}} 
| where query matches /{{query_regex}}/

| ((query_end_time - query_start_time ) /1000 / 60 ) as time_range_m
//| sort execution_duration_ms
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Infrequent" as inf_scan_bytes nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Flex" as flex_scan_bytes nodrop

| if (isnull(inf_scan_bytes),0,inf_scan_bytes) as inf_scan_bytes
| if (isnull(flex_scan_bytes),0,flex_scan_bytes) as flex_scan_bytes

| round(data_scanned_bytes /1Gi,1) as scan_gbytes
| inf_scan_bytes/1Gi as inf_scan_gbytes
| flex_scan_bytes/1Gi as flex_scan_gbytes
| round(inf_scan_gbytes + flex_scan_gbytes,1) as billable_scan_gb
| round(time_range_m/60 ,1) as time_range_h
| round(time_range_h/24,1 ) as time_range_d
| count as searches, sum(scan_gbytes) as scan_gb, sum(billable_scan_gb) as billed_scan_gb, max(scanned_partition_count) as max_partitions, avg(time_range_d) as avg_range_d, sum(execution_duration_ms) as ms_dur by user_name, query, query_type 
| sort billed_scan_gb | limit 1000
| round(ms_dur / ( 60000),2) as %"runtime(m)" | fields - ms_dur
//| sort avg_exec_ms

(_view=sumologic_search_usage_per_query) 
(query_type=*agent* or query_type=Mobot) not user_name=*sumosupport*
user_name={{user_name}} 
query={{query_pattern}} 
| where query matches /{{query_regex}}/

| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Infrequent" as inf_scan_bytes nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Flex" as flex_scan_bytes nodrop

| if (isnull(inf_scan_bytes),0,inf_scan_bytes) as inf_scan_bytes
| if (isnull(flex_scan_bytes),0,flex_scan_bytes) as flex_scan_bytes

| round(data_scanned_bytes /1Gi,1) as scan_gbytes
| inf_scan_bytes/1Gi as inf_scan_gbytes
| flex_scan_bytes/1Gi as flex_scan_gbytes
| round(inf_scan_gbytes + flex_scan_gbytes,1) as billable_scan_gb

| concat(user_name," (",query_type,")") as user_name
| count as searches, sum(data_scanned_bytes) as scan_bytes, sum(billable_scan_gb) as billable_scan_gb,avg(scanned_partition_count) as avg_partitions_scanned, sum(retrieved_message_count) as retrieved_events by user_name 
| round((scan_bytes /1024/1024/1024) * 10 )/10 as scan_gb
| fields -scan_bytes | sort searches

panels.title: Scan By Metering Tier - Response Agent

queries.queryString:
(_view=sumologic_search_usage_per_query) 
(query_type=*agent*) not user_name=*sumosupport*
user_name={{user_name}} 
query={{query_pattern}} 
| where query matches /{{query_regex}}/

| parse regex field=scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type "(?<tier>[^\",:]+)\" *: *(?<bytes>\d+)" multi
| if(tier = "Flex" or tier = "Infrequent", concat(tier,"($)"),tier) as tier
| bytes /1G as gb
| sum(gb) as gb by user_name , tier | transpose row user_name column tier

(_view=sumologic_search_usage_per_query) 
(query_type=*agent* or query_type=Mobot) not user_name=*sumosupport*
user_name={{user_name}} 
query={{query_pattern}} 
| where query matches /{{query_regex}}/
| timeslice 24 buckets
| count as searches, count_distinct(user_name) as users by _timeslice

panels.title: Security Response Agent Search Audit Details
Mobot Search Audit Session Data
panels.text:
These panels use search audit data for Mobot or `*agent*` query_type. They can be filtered by user_name, query_pattern or query_regex.
Search Audit index to show searches run using the query assistant feature which can be called copilot or mobot.

You can filter by various filters. note:
- using a query match pattern will speed up the search. This is a case sensitive match filter vs the query column
- the regex query filter is very powerful but also slower
- other filters are vs a column before the first | so must match the whole colum for example ```*value*``` but are case insensitive

panels.title: Response Agent - Mobot Conversations
panels.text: These panels show security investigation Mobot prompt session audit data. It can be filtered by **user_name ONLY.**

panels.title: Security Response Agent Investigations
panels.text: These panels show AI investigations triggered by SOC Analyst Agent. Since these are not user triggered you cannot use filters on these panels. You can use AI_investigation_filter as a keyword expression filter vs the sumologic_audit_events.
